text:
jamie: Thinking about a small UX tweak — add a 'Per-model overlay' toggle to the route inspector so you can see model-level telemetry (latency/cost/quality) on top of per-route metrics. quick take?

tao: I like it, especially for routing decisions. question: is this just a visual overlay or does it change saved query semantics?

jamie: Visual-first. Saved queries stay per-route. Overlay would be an ephemeral layer you can pin. If you pin it, we persist an association: route view + model overlay.

marisol: Concern: people will expect filter persistence for overlays. We should be explicit in the UI that overlays are "insights" not filter predicates. UX copy can say "Overlay metrics — not applied to traffic".

kevin: Telemetry note: model-level stats live in a different backend and are sampled at different rates. If overlay requests additional samples we should throttle or use cached aggregates to avoid cost spike.

beth: +1 to cached aggregates. Also: can we show quota burn-rate per model in that overlay? It'll help route owners decide fallback models.

tao: On the API side, do we extend saved-query object or have a separate saved-overlay object? I vote separate to keep existing saved-query contract stable.

jamie: Agreed separate. Proposed shape (very rough):
```json
{
  "overlay_id": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "model_scope": ["model-v1","model-v2"],
  "metrics": ["p95_latency","cost_per_token","quality_delta"],
  "pinned": true
}
```

marisol: That works. UX will need a quick toggle in the save dialog: "Save overlay with view" vs "Save overlay for org". Permission checks apply.

tao: Dev question: routing hints + overlays — if overlay shows a model has a high error-rate, do we want an automated routing suggestion? That's bordering on control-plane changes. I'd rather surface suggestions in the UI first.

kevin: Suggestion: show a subtle yellow banner: "Model X has elevated errors — consider fallback Y" with a link to a proposed rollout playbook. No automatic routing changes.

beth: For rollout UX, add an A/B compare mode where overlay can be switched between two models to compare metrics side-by-side for the same route and time window.

jamie: Love that. We should prototype the side-by-side first. Implementation notes:
- Frontend renders two time-aligned metric series for selected models.
- Backend endpoint: /insights/route-overlay?route_id=...&models=...&metrics=...
- Response should be aggregated buckets so we can stay within telemetry sampling limits.

tao: API naming: call it /v1/route-insights/overlays to keep it distinct from saved-queries. Also plan auth scope overlays:read overlays:write.

marisol: One more product nuance — saved overlays should support per-team visibility. Many teams share routes but not models. We need owner/visibility fields.

jamie: Yeah. Persist visibility as: personal, team, org. UI defaults to team when created inside a team workspace.

kevin: Telemetry backfill question: when someone pins an overlay for a historical window we might not have all model-level aggregates cached. Plan: fall back to best-effort and show a small footnote: "historical aggregates incomplete".

beth: Can we add a lightweight eval metric (prompt-level quality sample) into overlays for quality signal? Might be heavy but super valuable for model tradeoffs.

tao: If we include eval snippets, ensure PII-safe sampling and opt-in per org. That adds compliance work.

jamie: OK checklist for initial ship:
1) Prototype UI: overlay toggle + pin (marisol)
2) Backend endpoint returning aggregated model metrics (tao + kevin)
3) Saved-overlay object and permissions (tao)
4) Side-by-side compare MVP (beth)
5) Telemetry sampling safety + footnote (kevin)
6) Docs + rollout notes + audit trail (marisol)

marisol: I'll mock screens and copy. Want to avoid the confusion between "filters" and "overlays" so I'll add a small tooltip and an onboarding hint.

tao: I'll start a branch and prototype the API. Will @mention when I have the swagger.

deploy-bot: new deploy queued by tao for branch feature/route-overlay (preview env).

jamie: Thanks all — let's sync next week after the prototype. @marisol please drop the mock in #design when ready :thumbsup:

kevin: One tiny UX ask: add an option to show delta vs baseline model (checkbox) so the overlay can surface 'this model is +12% latency than baseline' quickly.

beth: noted. That will be super helpful for quick decisions.

jamie: End: leaving this thread as the source of truth for the feature spec. Will create GH issue and link.
